title: The Club Safari and the kitty
summary: Fired from the Sands, Safari job and the overtime kitty money that led to a counter's embezzlement arrest.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: You know where Safari was? Yeah, Safari was.

He used to come around trying to get us all the time, but we didn't want to go, because you know. But after the Cat fired us, we started working out there. Making more money, man, and everything. You know. That one guy used to come around, man. That guy, man, used to, like when we'd knock off at the Safari, he'd have his girlfriend there and have us playing overtime because he'd keep filling the kitty with money. You know? Man, and see what happened, when I was around for Danny, I wasn't charging him nothing. So Ernest Holland told Danny, I said, well man, why don't you give Curtis the kitty? Yeah, that's the money.

The kitty. You know, that was coming, the kitty. So man, we was at the Club Sands. The kitty wasn't much, you know, but four or five dollars a night. But when this guy started coming every night, man, I used to bring home 70, 80, 100, 150 dollars a night, you know. Because sometimes the cat said, man, well, you're going to pay a little over. And you know, and them cats wasn't fucking, they wasn't getting nothing. So I said, well man, look, I'll pay you all for whatever. You know? So what happened, man? The cat was putting so much money in the kitty until Urban told him one night. He said, man, what kind of work you do? He said, well, I'm a counter. And the old one was just joking with him. He said, man, you must be juggling the books or something, you know. The cat laughed, you know. And man, he started putting so much money in there, Fox told Danny, he said, man, look, see, this is your band, see. See, the cat doing the random for him, see, we're going to have to start splitting the kitty, man, saying you've got to start paying the cat for your ram. I said, well that's fine with me, so I can pay you some kind of way, you know. But Fox said he wanted some of that money, you know. So man, right after that happened, guess what happened? He seen people the next day with a cat, about the next few days, after he had made that deal about, you know, me. Well this cat got busted for embezzlement, man. Oh, correct. You know, so I was in, that's Mr. Kitty. Well that's. So he left with Danny Stead to pay me, see. But man, this is going to show you what, what, what Irvin was joking about was true.

But guess what, the cat must have been so good to him, they bust him in, he didn't even do no time. But, and then he finally wind up getting his job back. But then he turned around and messed up again, did the same thing over again. Man.
